name: ROVVER X
def: Six wheel drive tethered sewer inspection crawler with a pan and tilt camera, driven by a technician from a surface reel and controller.
body: ROVVER X is a modular six wheel drive crawler that is lowered through a manhole and driven along a sewer or culvert while a pan, tilt and zoom camera records the pipe wall. Wheels, axles and camera modules swap out to match pipe diameter, and a powered reel feeds cable while keeping tension under control. The operator works from a controller and screen in a survey van, coding defects as the run proceeds. Municipal and contractor crews use it for condition assessment of buried pipe.
facts: Inspects pipe from small municipal laterals up to large diameter trunk mains
A satellite camera variant inspects lateral connections from inside the mainline
Widely used by North American municipal sewer departments and inspection contractors
specs: Six wheel drive crawler with interchangeable wheels and axles for different pipe diameters
Power and data supplied over the tether from a motorised surface reel
Pan, tilt and zoom camera with lighting, plus optional laser profiling and sonar modules
Remotely operated from a surface controller, with powered cable management
